scenario.summary: Signed in, on the configurable PDP opened by the head method: selects the seventh variant of the chain by its attribute values, verifies its name, SKU, short description, price, quantity validations and Details/Specifications/Shipping panels, and adds it to the cart.
steps: Select variant7's Bulb Size, Color and Technology
Verify name, 'SKU:' + SKU, short description and price
Verify Read Reviews link and default quantity
Type 0 and blank quantity, verify the validation messages
Verify Details, Specifications and Shipping panels and the Write a Review link
Add to cart and verify the cart count
stateChanges: Account cart: variant7 added (quantity 1); emptied by configurableProductRemoveAllItemsFromCartAndLoggOff
assertions: Name, SKU, short description, price and panel texts equal variant7's
Zero and blank quantity validation messages
evidence: Class chain, first method captures (user decision 2026-11-04): configurableProductSearchForConfigurableProduct runs first and declares every record need of the chain (product, variant1..variant8); the migrated class keeps the resolved records in class fields and the later methods read them (SkipException DATA_UNAVAILABLE when a field is null), so they declare no product needs of their own. This method reads variant7 (class field). The variant SKU it reads today (z-25100020) is declared as a source of configurableProductSearchForConfigurableProduct (variant7.variantSku); until the class is migrated, check-hardcoded reports it here.

Read by the page object, not scanned: verifyDetailsOfProductVarient selects the variant by ProductSize/ProductColor/Technology and asserts ProductName, 'SKU:' + SKU, ShortDescription, ProductPrice, ProductDetails, ProductSpecification and Shipping of the variant's column -> variant7.swatches, variantName, variantSku, shortDescription, price, details, specifications, shippingInfo; then adds InitialQuantity (config 1) and checks the cart count (the page object's counter, one more per variant).
Labels: the 'SKU:' prefix and the zero/blank quantity validation messages are UI texts (expected-output); the zero quantity '0' the test types is config.

DECLARED ACCOUNT (per method): the class signs in once in configurableProductSearchForConfigurableProduct with loginPage.successfullLogin(testClassRetailUsers/configurableProductPDPTest Username, Password; loginAndRegistration!B176/C176) and every later method works in that signed-in session (its cart, wishlist, review). An account lease is held by the declaring method only, so each method declares user = USER_WEBSTORE_REGISTERED {store MaxwellsHardware}, preferred {source: the username source, required: true}, declared at method start with Tda.declareUser (useExisting), as the Selenium quickOrder retail entries. Username/password stay credential sources (masked) the test keeps reading from its own sheet; the scanner recorded them only on the head method, here the same two cells are declared from the test source (the session it reuses).

Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware), the same store as the Selenium shoppingCart/quickOrder entries and the Playwright pdp entries.

Profile: work/profiles/profile.json (2026-11-01) has no observations for these Selenium cells (profiled false); DB facts from bin/tda rows (2026-11-06) and the approved Playwright pdp entries where cited.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, delays, image extension) are framework constants: role config, no need.
